lines.zh: 湿沙粘在脚上，一步一个水印。
lines.en: Wet sand clings to my feet; every step leaves a watermark.

lines.zh: 河流浅处，正是我散步的地方。
lines.en: The shallow river is exactly where I take my walks.

lines.zh: 水从肋骨缝里漏下来，一直漏。
lines.en: Water leaks between my ribs, and keeps on leaking.

lines.zh: 三叉戟在背后晃，像一条鱼尾。
lines.en: The trident sways on my back like a fish tail.

lines.zh: 走上岸，太阳把我的皮晒得发紧。
lines.en: On land, the sun pulls my skin tight.

lines.zh: 我踩着河底的淤泥，不发出声音。
lines.en: I tread the river mud without making a sound.

lines.zh: 海水推我一把，我顺势往前走。
lines.en: The sea shoves me, and I let it push me on.

lines.zh: 每一脚都踩进深水，我就这么走。
lines.en: Every step lands in deep water; that's how I walk.

lines.zh: 岸上的路太干了，走起来费劲。
lines.en: The dry road is hard going for legs like mine.

lines.zh: 鱼群让开，我沿着河床慢行。
lines.en: The fish part, and I move slowly along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水草缠住脚踝，我懒得理会。
lines.en: Weeds snag my ankle, and I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 泡得太久，走到哪里都滴水。
lines.en: Soaked too long; I drip wherever I go.

lines.zh: 水泡从喉咙里冒出来，咕噜咕噜。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my throat, glub, glub.

lines.zh: 我站在水草里，等天彻底黑透。
lines.en: I stand in the weeds, waiting for full dark.

lines.zh: 河底的石头，比岸上的人有趣。
lines.en: The stones on the riverbed are better company than people.

lines.zh: 我数自己的心跳，早就没有了。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats; they've been gone a while.

lines.zh: 头发在水里散开，像一片海带。
lines.en: My hair spreads in the water like a strip of kelp.

lines.zh: 盐把皮肤咬得发白，我早习惯了。
lines.en: Salt has bitten my skin pale; I'm long used to it.

lines.zh: 潮水走了又回来，我一动不动。
lines.en: The tide leaves and returns; I don't move at all.

lines.zh: 水面上有月亮，可我够不着。
lines.en: There's a moon on the water, but out of my reach.

lines.zh: 我在听暗流说话，它从不撒谎。
lines.en: I listen to the undercurrent; it never lies.

lines.zh: 沉船的木片飘过来，我推开了。
lines.en: A splinter of wreckage drifts by; I push it away.

lines.zh: 你也湿了，是下河捞东西吗？
lines.en: You're wet too. Did you come down for something?

lines.zh: 别站在岸上盯着我，水里有位置。
lines.en: Don't stare from the bank; there's room in the water.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子在水里被拉长。
lines.en: I see your shadow stretched long in the water.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛真亮，像两条小鱼。
lines.en: Living eyes are so bright, like two little fish.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的河了，退回去吧。
lines.en: You've stepped into my river. Go back.

lines.zh: 你手里那盏灯，在水下不管用。
lines.en: That lantern won't help you underwater.

lines.zh: 我其实在看你身后，水面在动。
lines.en: I'm actually watching behind you; the surface is moving.

lines.zh: 你把靴子弄湿了，早晚的事。
lines.en: You've soaked your boots. It was only a matter of time.

lines.zh: 我从水底看你，你比实际更高。
lines.en: I see you from below; you look taller than you are.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我怕你认错了人。
lines.en: Don't blink; I'd hate for you to mistake me.

lines.zh: 不疼，只是又湿了一层。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt; I'm just wetter than before.

lines.zh: 你打散了我的头发，水会理顺。
lines.en: You've scattered my hair; the water will comb it.

lines.zh: 我早就死过一次，再来一次无妨。
lines.en: I've died once already; again is no trouble.

lines.zh: 骨头响了，别当是碎了。
lines.en: That creak is bone, not breaking.

lines.zh: 水从伤口灌进去，倒凉快。
lines.en: Water pours into the wound; it's cooling, actually.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可惜我不用喘气。
lines.en: You hit me, but I've no breath to lose.

lines.zh: 沙子和盐一起掉下来。
lines.en: Sand and salt fall off together.

lines.zh: 这一下够我记你到退潮。
lines.en: This one will last me until the tide goes out.

lines.zh: 我的皮早泡烂了，挡不住什么。
lines.en: My hide rotted long ago; it stops nothing.

lines.zh: 疼是活人的事。
lines.en: Pain is a living thing's business.

lines.zh: 别拿面包哄我，我咽不下去。
lines.en: Don't wave bread at me; I can't swallow it.

lines.zh: 活人的饭香，闻着让我恶心。
lines.en: The smell of living food turns my stomach.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟食，也不吃你递的。
lines.en: I don't eat cooked food, and not what you hand me.

lines.zh: 想引我，就端一盆海水过来。
lines.en: To lure me, bring a basin of seawater.

lines.zh: 火把离我远些，我只想要凉。
lines.en: Keep the torch farther off; I only want cool.

lines.zh: 腐肉放久了，才有我要的味道。
lines.en: Rotten flesh has the taste I want once it's old.

lines.zh: 我在找水，不是来找吃的。
lines.en: I'm looking for water, not for a meal.

lines.zh: 菜叶子对我没用，别再晃了。
lines.en: Leaves do nothing for me. Stop waving them.

lines.zh: 你要是掉进河里，才算引到了我。
lines.en: If you fall in the river, then you've tempted me.

lines.zh: 我是饿，但饿的不是肚子。
lines.en: I am hungry, but not in the belly.

lines.zh: 让开，我的皮是冷的，不好碰。
lines.en: Step aside; my skin is cold and bad to touch.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一袋湿沙子。
lines.en: You bump into me like a sack of wet sand.

lines.zh: 别贴着，水会从我这流到你那。
lines.en: Don't press close; the water runs off me onto you.

lines.zh: 我身上滴的水，现在算你的了。
lines.en: The water dripping off me is yours now.

lines.zh: 你挡在浅滩上，我过不去。
lines.en: You're blocking the shallows, and I can't get past.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我骨头响，你不响。
lines.en: One bump: my bones creak, yours don't.

lines.zh: 退半格，我不咬人咬这么近。
lines.en: Half a step back; I don't bite that close.

lines.zh: 湿脚踩湿脚，谁也怪不了谁。
lines.en: Wet feet on wet feet; neither of us can complain.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的汗了，太热了。
lines.en: I smell your sweat. It's too warm.

lines.zh: 别推，我一倒进水里就没了影。
lines.en: Don't shove; once I fall in, I'm gone.

lines.zh: 死人还谈什么成双，泡着就行。
lines.en: What pairing is left for the dead? We just soak.

lines.zh: 我这些同伴都是淹出来的，不是生的。
lines.en: My kin were drowned into being, not born.

lines.zh: 想要更多溺尸，把僵尸按进水里。
lines.en: Want more of us? Hold a zombie under the water.

lines.zh: 别问配偶，我连名字都泡掉了。
lines.en: Don't ask about a mate; I soaked away even my name.

lines.zh: 河底够挤了，不用再添小的。
lines.en: The riverbed is crowded enough without adding little ones.

lines.zh: 海里的溺尸跟着潮水，不跟着我。
lines.en: The drowned at sea follow the tide, not me.

lines.zh: 我们聚成群，只因水冷得一样。
lines.en: We gather only because the water chills us alike.

lines.zh: 繁衍是活人的事，我负责捞人。
lines.en: Breeding is the living's business; I do the dragging.

lines.zh: 你留下的话，几天就跟我一个色。
lines.en: Stay a few days and you'll match my color.

lines.zh: 我没有可传的东西，腐肉都得抢。
lines.en: I've nothing to pass on; I even fight for rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 这块铜锈得正好，我捡走了。
lines.en: This copper is rusted just right; I'll take it.

lines.zh: 三叉戟掉了要捡，那是我的牙。
lines.en: A dropped trident must be retrieved; it's my teeth.

lines.zh: 腐肉不算好东西，有总比没有强。
lines.en: Rotten flesh is nothing much, but better than none.

lines.zh: 我捡走你的靴子，它反正会湿。
lines.en: I'll take your boots; they'd get wet anyway.

lines.zh: 水底的贝壳，我一枚也不留。
lines.en: Shells on the bottom: I leave not a single one.

lines.zh: 谁丢的钓竿？我替你沉到河心。
lines.en: Whose fishing rod? I'll sink it mid-river for you.

lines.zh: 陆上的东西太干，捡了也拿不住。
lines.en: Things on land are too dry; even held, they slip.

lines.zh: 沉船上还有铁，我慢慢往怀里塞。
lines.en: There's still iron on the wreck; I tuck it away slowly.

lines.zh: 别捡我脚边那块，那是我藏的。
lines.en: Don't take the piece by my foot; that one's mine.

lines.zh: 铜锭沉得快，正合我这种胃口。
lines.en: Copper ingots sink fast; that suits a taste like mine.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太响，隔着水都听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud, even through the water.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，就已经是我的了。
lines.en: You on the bank are already mine.

lines.zh: 这一带的水，归我看着。
lines.en: This stretch of water is mine to watch.

lines.zh: 我闻到活人的热气，从上游来。
lines.en: I smell living warmth, coming from upstream.

lines.zh: 你踏碎了我水面上的月光。
lines.en: You broke the moonlight on my water.

lines.zh: 别跑向深水，那正好省我几步。
lines.en: Don't run to deep water; it saves me the walk.

lines.zh: 我锁上你了，像钩子锁住鱼嘴。
lines.en: I've got you, like a hook in a fish's mouth.

lines.zh: 你手里那支三叉戟，我也想要。
lines.en: That trident of yours — I'd like one too.

lines.zh: 河水已经在替你数剩下的步子。
lines.en: The river is counting your remaining steps.

lines.zh: 你从桥上下来，我就当是下水了。
lines.en: Step off the bridge and I count you as in the water.

lines.zh: 灯笼照到我脸时，我已经动了。
lines.en: By the time your lantern finds my face, I've moved.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了龟蛋，这海岸都记着。
lines.en: You crushed the turtle eggs; this whole coast remembers.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在水里传得很远。
lines.en: Your heartbeat carries far underwater.

lines.zh: 我挑中你了，别怪潮水。
lines.en: I've picked you. Don't blame the tide.

lines.zh: 你在水边蹲下，我就当是邀请。
lines.en: You crouch by the water; I take it as an invitation.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就站在深水里了。
lines.en: One more step back and you're in deep water.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，水会把你送过来。
lines.en: I'm slow, but the water will send you over.

lines.zh: 把灯放下，你能把我看得更清楚。
lines.en: Put the lantern down; you'll see me better.

lines.zh: 三叉戟举起来了，别眨眼。
lines.en: The trident is up. Don't blink.

lines.zh: 水面这么平，正好按你下去。
lines.en: The surface is so calm, perfect for pressing you under.

lines.zh: 你身后是深水，前面是我。
lines.en: Deep water behind you, and me in front.

lines.zh: 别游，你游不过泡了百年的东西。
lines.en: Don't swim; you can't outswim a century of soaking.

lines.zh: 我数到三，潮水就到了。
lines.en: I'll count to three, and the tide will be here.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太重，跑不远的。
lines.en: Your boots are heavy; you won't get far.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己滑进水里。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to slide in on your own.

lines.zh: 水声会盖住你的求救。
lines.en: The water will cover the sound of you calling for help.

lines.zh: 别朝亮处跑，那边更深。
lines.en: Don't run toward the light; it's deeper there.

lines.zh: 你踩的是我的浅滩，退出去。
lines.en: You're standing on my shallows. Get out.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路泡软了。
lines.en: I've soaked your way out until it's soft.

lines.zh: 我顺着河沟走，水替我掩着声。
lines.en: I come up the channel; the water muffles me.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我不躲。
lines.en: You lift the torch high; I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我停在水下，只露一点头顶。
lines.en: I wait submerged with only my scalp showing.

lines.zh: 你退过那块礁石，就到我了。
lines.en: Once you pass that rock, you are mine.

lines.zh: 三叉戟往前一送，水花跟着。
lines.en: The trident goes forward, and the spray follows.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚踝，往下一拽。
lines.en: I grab your ankle and pull it down.

lines.zh: 这一下，是河底教会我的。
lines.en: The riverbed taught me this one.

lines.zh: 别挣扎，淤泥会替你闭嘴。
lines.en: Stop struggling; the mud will do the shushing.

lines.zh: 我指甲里全是盐，划一下够你记。
lines.en: My nails are full of salt; one scratch will stay with you.

lines.zh: 你喊吧，水面上只会冒泡。
lines.en: Shout all you like; only bubbles reach the surface.

lines.zh: 一叉下去，你的灯就灭了。
lines.en: One thrust, and your lantern goes out.

lines.zh: 我把你往深处拖，那里安静。
lines.en: I drag you deeper, where it's quiet.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，水替我挡了一下。
lines.en: You missed; the water took that one for me.

lines.zh: 冷手贴上来，比刀还难受。
lines.en: A cold hand on you is worse than a blade.

lines.zh: 你越挣扎，沉得越快。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the faster you sink.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在肩上，水会灌进去。
lines.en: This bite lands on the shoulder; the water gets in.

lines.zh: 我把你翻过来，像翻一块石头。
lines.en: I turn you over like flipping a stone.

lines.zh: 河会替我收尾，我只管开头。
lines.en: The river will finish it; I only start.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的小腿上。
lines.en: I bite down on your calf.

lines.zh: 湿冷的手扣住你的手腕。
lines.en: A cold wet hand locks your wrist.

lines.zh: 我从河底站起来，水才到腰。
lines.en: I rise from the riverbed, water at my waist.

lines.zh: 又一只僵尸沉下来，正好添个伴。
lines.en: Another zombie sank; good, a new companion.

lines.zh: 亮度为零的河湾，最适合睁眼。
lines.en: A river bend at zero light is the best place to open my eyes.

lines.zh: 暖水海域太亮，我挑了河沟。
lines.en: Warm seas are too bright; I chose the ditch.

lines.zh: 我这一身绿，是慢慢泡出来的。
lines.en: This green of mine was soaked into me, slowly.

lines.zh: 溶洞的水潭里，我浮了上来。
lines.en: I surfaced in a pool inside the cavern.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推上岸，我就站着。
lines.en: The tide pushed me ashore, so here I stand.

lines.zh: 别问是谁把我按进水里的。
lines.en: Don't ask who held me under.

lines.zh: 冻洋的冰下面，我照样睁眼。
lines.en: Under the frozen ocean's ice, I still open my eyes.

lines.zh: 河流的暗处，比海更疼我。
lines.en: The dark of the river is kinder to me than the sea.

lines.zh: 我数着水泡上浮，数到十就醒了。
lines.en: I counted the rising bubbles; at ten I woke.

lines.zh: 深海的水压，把我的骨头压实了。
lines.en: Deep-sea pressure packed my bones tight.

lines.zh: 我出生那天，河水涨了一寸。
lines.en: The day I was born, the river rose an inch.

lines.zh: 这片水归我了，谁也别争。
lines.en: This water is mine now. Let no one contest it.

lines.zh: 火离我远点，我怕烤干。
lines.en: Keep the fire off me; I don't want to dry out.

lines.zh: 摔进水里的，不算摔。
lines.en: Falling into water doesn't count as falling.

lines.zh: 我一直泡着，别跟我说憋气。
lines.en: I've been soaking all along; don't tell me to hold my breath.

lines.zh: 炸起的水柱，比你还高。
lines.en: The water column you raised is taller than you.

lines.zh: 箭沉下来了，我捞给你。
lines.en: The arrow sank; I'll fish it out for you.

lines.zh: 魔法在我骨头里打滑。
lines.en: Magic slips off my bones.

lines.zh: 饿不死的东西，也会觉得空。
lines.en: Even something that can't starve can feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我跟着抖。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I shake with it.

lines.zh: 我沉到底了，水怎么没了？
lines.en: I've sunk to the bottom; where did the water go?
